Look no further than our electrifying Miami Party Cruise, the ultimate 90-minute floating celebration exclusively for adults aged 21 and over! As the sun dips below the horizon and the city lights begin to sparkle, our Miami party boat sets sail, taking you on a dynamic journey through the exhilarating waterways.
